items.title: Maruti Suzuki starts production at second plant of Kharkhoda facility
items.description: The second plant has an annual production capacity of 2.5 lakh units, taking the total capacity at Kharkhoda to 5 lakh units, Maruti Suzuki said in a statement

items.title: Global Health: FY26 performance reinforces long-term growth visibility
items.description: Strong execution, coupled with expansion, reinforces Medanta’s medium-term growth visibility despite near-term ramp-up costs in Noida

items.title: NCC Limited: West Asia crisis to weigh on near-term earnings
items.description: NCC has refrained from providing FY2027 guidance on important financial parameters such as revenue growth, order inflow, and EBIDTA and net profit margins

items.title: Rupee at 96 per dollar will eat into fuel price hike relief for OMCs
items.description: The rupee’s sharp depreciation is emerging as a fresh headache for oil retailers even after the government raised fuel prices for the first time in 4 years

items.title: Bharti Enterprises to sell 75% stake in Bharti Life to Prudential for Rs 3,500 crore
items.description: The transaction will see Prudential acquire the controlling stake from Bharti Life Ventures Pvt Ltd and funds managed by 360 ONE Asset Management.
